scores.scale: 0 = unusable in observed conditions; 5 = functional with substantial friction; 7 = good with clear limitations; 9 = excellent with little observed friction; 10 = exceptional. Subjective holistic grades, not calculated from win/loss, accuracy, speed or an arithmetic average.

reasons.overall_mobile: A coherent atmospheric mission with approachable visible touch assists and clear completion. Crowded HUD, small dark threats and limited manual combat coverage constrain confidence. Two wins alone do not establish quality.
reasons.controls: Large labeled buttons and tap aim were workable. Manual MOVE and simultaneous FIRE/scene drags visibly responded, but only briefly. Tap aim reorients the camera; stopping FIRE on target shutdown took observation. DASH, JUMP, tools and zoom were not assessed. Assisted routes alone do not assess manual controls.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery, timed coil exposures and uplink provide a comprehensible sequence. Coil progress was satisfying to observe. Much traversal was holding assistance, and surviving the upload without engaging patrols gave limited evidence of combat depth. No enjoyment inferred for unassessed content.
reasons.presentation: Rain, teal industrial lighting, architectural silhouettes and restrained title/results styling form a strong consistent mood at 844x390. Audio unassessed.
reasons.usability: Route/approach wording, map selection, coil states, upload percentage and explicit fresh-start action reduce ambiguity. Numerous simultaneous instructions and large overlays compete for attention.
reasons.readability: Health, ammo, coil OFF and terminal statistics are legible; distant signs and patrol silhouettes are small against dark geometry. HUD and touch controls obscure substantial scene area.
